popCulture.creator: Herodotus
popCulture.description: Book 9: Tegeans claim Echemus slew Hyllus in single combat and turned back the first Heraclid invasion — Arcadian pride marshalled before Plataea.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Records Echemus of Tegea as the champion who killed Hyllus and forced the Heracleidae to withdraw for a generation.

popCulture.title: Echemus
popCulture.description: Arcadian king of Tegea who defeated Hyllus — the duel that delayed the Return of the Heracleidae.
